subject: Extend gate worktree enforcement to all subagents (not just metric tasks)
description:
The orch-gate hooks only enforce orch/attempt/* branch isolation when the claimed task has a metric spec. Regular parallel subagents pass through unchecked and write to main simultaneously, causing overwrites.

Fix:
1. hooks/orch-gate.sh: replace HAS_METRIC conditional with is_subagent check — if subagent + not on orch/attempt/* -> block. Drop the /task/detail round-trip.
2. hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh: same change.
3. skills/parallel-orchestrate/SKILL.md: add branch_task(task_key) as required second step in worker contract (after start_task).
4. CLAUDE.md: update gate contract to include branch_task as required before any write.

summary: Extended worktree branch isolation from metric-only to all subagent claims. Changed the HAS_METRIC check (jq .task.metric != null) to a TASK_BRANCH check (jq .task.git.branch) in both hooks/orch-gate.sh and hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh. Any task with a registered git branch (i.e. branch_task was called) now enforces orch/attempt/* branch isolation — not just metric tasks. Added 2 regression tests to test/orch-gate-bash.test.js: one confirming non-metric tasks with a worktree branch are blocked on main (exit 2 with descriptive message), one confirming tasks without a worktree branch remain unrestricted (exit 0). All 39 bash gate tests and 15 edit gate tests pass. Worktree: /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/worktrees/62dae274979b8432/local-gate-worktree-all-subagents, branch: orch/attempt/local-gate-worktree-all-subagents.
